items.title: CVE-2026-102764: exploited vulnerability in BeyondTrust Remote Support
items.note: BeyondTrust Remote Support contains an authentication bypass by spoofing vulnerability that could allow a remote attacker to perform file operations on the appliance.

items.title: CVE-2025-61624: exploited vulnerability in Fortinet Multiple Products
items.note: FortiOS, FortiPAM, FortiProxy, and FortiSwitchManager contain a path traversal vulnerability that may allow an authenticated attacker with admin profile and at least read-write permissions to write or delete arbitrary files via specific CLI commands.

items.title: CVE-2026-21589: exploited vulnerability in Atlassian Multiple Products
items.note: Multiple Atlassian products (Bitbucket Data Center ,Confluence Data Center, Jira Service Management Data Center, Jira Software Data Center, Bamboo Data Center, Crowd Data Center, Crucible and Fisheye) contain a files or directories accessible to external parties vulnerability which could allow an unauthenticated attacker to access specific files within the web application root directory in affected versions.

items.title: CVE-2026-105134: exploited vulnerability in Ahsay AhsayCBS
items.note: Ahsay AhsayCBS contains a command injection vulnerability that could allow a remote attacker to execute operating system commands via manipulation of the random parameter in the Replication Receiver component’s /rps/api/json/UpdateReceivers.do endpoint. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-105133.

items.title: CVE-2026-76519: exploited vulnerability in Cisco Secure Email Gateway
items.note: Cisco Secure Email Gateway contains a relative path traversal vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to write arbitrary files on the underlying operating system.

items.title: CVE-2026-105133: exploited vulnerability in Ahsay AhsayCBS
items.note: Ahsay AhsayCBS contains an improper authentication vulnerability that could allow a remote attacker to bypass authentication via manipulation of the random parameter in the API component’s checkSysPwd function. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-105134.

items.title: CVE-2026-0322: exploited vulnerability in Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS
items.note: Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS contains a code injection vulnerability that could allow an authenticated attacker with network access to execute arbitrary code with root privileges on the firewall.

items.title: CVE-2026-104935: exploited vulnerability in Ivanti Connect Secure
items.note: Ivanti Connect Secure contains an authentication bypass by spoofing vulnerability that allows a remote unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary commands.

items.title: CVE-2026-96951: exploited vulnerability in Microsoft Windows
items.note: Microsoft Windows Shell contains a command injection vulnerability that allows an unauthorized attacker to bypass a security feature over a network.

items.title: CVE-2015-5477: exploited vulnerability in ISC BIND
items.note: ISC BIND contains a data processing errors vulnerability that could allow remote attackers to cause a denial of service via TKEY queries.

items.title: CVE-2016-3081: exploited vulnerability in Apache Struts
items.note: Apache Struts contains a command injection vulnerability that could allow remote attackers to execute arbitrary code via method:prefix when Dynamic Method Invocation is enabled.

items.title: CVE-2023-22894: exploited vulnerability in Strapi Strapi
items.note: Strapi contains a cleartext storage of sensitive information vulnerability that could allow attackers with access to the admin panel to discover sensitive user details via the query filter. The impacted product(s) could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users are advised to discontinue use and/or transition to a supported version. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2023-22621 to achieve remote code execution.

items.title: CVE-2021-3199: exploited vulnerability in ONLYOFFICE Docs
items.note: ONLYOFFICE Docs contains a path traversal vulnerability that can occur when JWT is used, via a /.. sequence in an image upload parameter and could allow for remote code execution.

items.title: CVE-2015-3306: exploited vulnerability in ProFTPD ProFTPD
items.note: ProFTPD contains an improper access control vulnerability that could allow remote attackers to read and write to arbitrary files via the site cpfr and site cpto commands.

items.title: CVE-2026-88779: exploited vulnerability in Citrix NetScaler
items.note: Citrix NetScaler ADC (formerly Citrix ADC) and Citrix NetScaler Gateway (formerly Citrix Gateway) contain an improper restriction of operations within the bounds of a memory buffer vulnerability that could allow for a denial of service.

items.title: CVE-2016-4658: recently changed critical CVE
items.note: xpointer.c in libxml2 before 2.9.5 (as used in Apple iOS before 10, OS X before 10.12, tvOS before 10, and watchOS before 3, and other products) does not forbid namespace nodes in XPointer ranges, which allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code or cause a denial of service (use-after-free and memory corruption) via a crafted XML document.

items.title: CVE-2017-5674: recently changed critical CVE
items.note: A vulnerability in a custom-built GoAhead web server used on Foscam, Vstarcam, and multiple white-label IP camera models allows an attacker to craft a malformed HTTP ("GET system.ini HTTP/1.1\n\n" - note the lack of "/" in the path field of the request) request that will disclose the configuration file with the login password.

items.title: CVE-2017-5648: recently changed critical CVE
items.note: While investigating bug 60718, it was noticed that some calls to application listeners in Apache Tomcat 9.0.0.M1 to 9.0.0.M17, 8.5.0 to 8.5.11, 8.0.0.RC1 to 8.0.41, and 7.0.0 to 7.0.75 did not use the appropriate facade object. When running an untrusted application under a SecurityManager, it was therefore possible for that untrusted application to retain a reference to the request or response object and thereby access and/or modify information associated with another web application.

items.title: CVE-2017-16931: recently changed critical CVE
items.note: parser.c in libxml2 before 2.9.5 mishandles parameter-entity references because the NEXTL macro calls the xmlParserHandlePEReference function in the case of a '%' character in a DTD name.

items.title: CVE-2017-7375: recently changed critical CVE
items.note: A flaw in libxml2 allows remote XML entity inclusion with default parser flags (i.e., when the caller did not request entity substitution, DTD validation, external DTD subset loading, or default DTD attributes). Depending on the context, this may expose a higher-risk attack surface in libxml2 not usually reachable with default parser flags, and expose content from local files, HTTP, or FTP servers (which might be otherwise unreachable).

items.title: CVE-2017-7376: recently changed critical CVE
items.note: Buffer overflow in libxml2 allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code by leveraging an incorrect limit for port values when handling redirects.

items.title: CVE-2018-7489: recently changed critical CVE
items.note: FasterXML jackson-databind before 2.7.9.3, 2.8.x before 2.8.11.1 and 2.9.x before 2.9.5 allows unauthenticated remote code execution because of an incomplete fix for the CVE-2017-7525 deserialization flaw. This is exploitable by sending maliciously crafted JSON input to the readValue method of the ObjectMapper, bypassing a blacklist that is ineffective if the c3p0 libraries are available in the classpath.

items.title: CVE-2018-8014: recently changed critical CVE
items.note: The defaults settings for the CORS filter provided in Apache Tomcat 9.0.0.M1 to 9.0.8, 8.5.0 to 8.5.31, 8.0.0.RC1 to 8.0.52, 7.0.41 to 7.0.88 are insecure and enable 'supportsCredentials' for all origins. It is expected that users of the CORS filter will have configured it appropriately for their environment rather than using it in the default configuration. Therefore, it is expected that most users will not be impacted by this issue.

items.title: CVE-2018-18928: recently changed critical CVE
items.note: International Components for Unicode (ICU) for C/C++ 63.1 has an integer overflow in number::impl::DecimalQuantity::toScientificString() in i18n/number_decimalquantity.cpp.

items.title: CVE-2018-19857: recently changed critical CVE
items.note: The CAF demuxer in modules/demux/caf.c in VideoLAN VLC media player 3.0.4 may read memory from an uninitialized pointer when processing magic cookies in CAF files, because a ReadKukiChunk() cast converts a return value to an unsigned int even if that value is negative. This could result in a denial of service and/or a potential infoleak.

items.title: CVE-2018-14720: recently changed critical CVE
items.note: FasterXML jackson-databind 2.x before 2.9.7 might allow attackers to conduct external XML entity (XXE) attacks by leveraging failure to block unspecified JDK classes from polymorphic deserialization.

items.title: CVE-2018-14721: recently changed critical CVE
items.note: FasterXML jackson-databind 2.x before 2.9.7 might allow remote attackers to conduct server-side request forgery (SSRF) attacks by leveraging failure to block the axis2-jaxws class from polymorphic deserialization.

items.title: Gîtes de France
items.source: Have I Been Pwned breach catalog
items.note: In May 2026, the French holiday rental network Gîtes de France suffered a data breach affecting some of its departmental branches. The incident exposed hundreds of thousands of customer records, including 118k unique email addresses alongside names, phone numbers, postal addresses and booking details.

items.title: Data broker privacy watch
items.note: Recheck broker opt-out results every 30-90 days; many brokers repopulate data. Keep broker name, profile URL, date requested, and confirmation emails.

items.title: Unwanted software / bloatware watch
items.note: Watch for software that changes browser settings, injects ads, bundles unwanted offers, hides removal paths, exaggerates cleanup claims, or uses misleading install prompts.

items.title: Remote-access scam reminder
items.source: WireShield guidance from FTC/CISA-style scam prevention
items.note: Treat unexpected requests to install AnyDesk, TeamViewer, UltraViewer, RustDesk, or ScreenConnect as high risk, especially when paired with refunds, bank warnings, crypto, or gift cards.
